allowed_use: Document the absence of an accepted native output

semantic_restrictions: Scores remain native candidate-space ranking quantities.

semantic_restrictions: T6 remains a query-level retrieval/ranking task.
observable_non_positive is not a true negative.
T6 must not be flattened into an ordinary binary classifier.

T6.calibration_boundary: Any later T6 confidence formulation must be defined around native query-level retrieval/ranking semantics rather than ordinary binary probability calibration.

semantic_restrictions: event=0 must not be relabelled as a negative resolution outcome.

OP-005.closure_statement: The T9 empirical boundary is frozen at the task-specific native-output level. T5 is the currently accepted native probability output. T4 and T6 remain native ranking quantities. T7 remains native survival/time-to-event output. T2 probability calibration is unavailable because no native probability artifact exists. T3 has no accepted native prediction artifact. No universal confidence or risk score is established.
